training_scope: official default: freeze VLM; update all 16 action expert layers, state and action interfaces
schedule_source: LeRobot SmolVLA defaults (lr 1e-4, betas 0.9/0.95, weight decay 1e-10, clip 10, warmup 1000, cosine to 2.5e-6), 15000 steps (experiment 1's best was at ~9 passes over its training frames; ~9 passes here is ~11700 steps); effective batch 64 = 16 x 4 accumulation on the local RTX 4060 8 GB
data_scope: experiment 2: two tasks, per-frame instruction from the dataset (key 98 + doll 100 teleoperated episodes, 187 train / 11 validation by episode); static tails trimmed to 0.5 s; top 1280x720 -> camera1, wrist 640x480 -> camera2, both resized with padding to 512; offline validation is action MAE on held-out episodes, not task success
